searchText: Does anyone know why the number of nodes has dropped nearly 70% in the last 24h? Number of nodes of what as reported by who? Looks like there is a problem with etherscan https://etherscan.io/nodetracker Which is where ethereum.org pulls its data from: Sorry I should have posted link and not just expected people to take my word for it https://etherscan.io/nodetracker Oh, never trust the last dot on any chart. 🙂 Recap of the interop event from last week just went up on the EF blog for anyone who wants more details on what happened and what's next: https://blog.ethereum.org/2021/10/15/amphora-merge-milestone/ Hahaha fair enough Thanks. Hopefully it’s sorted out soon
